question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **we**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"we"** means a group of people including the speaker. (हम)

 
 
• **Example: **We are going to the park this evening.
 
 
 
• **"Us" **refers to the objective case of the pronoun "we". It is used to refer to the group that includes the speaker as the object of a verb or preposition. (हमें)
 
 
• **Example: **She gave us a gift.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct pronoun to fill in the blank is **'we'**.
 
• The context tells us that we should avoid overindulging in food if we want to enjoy excellent health.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **we**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **us **(हमें): Used to refer to the group that includes the speaker as the object of a verb or preposition.

 
 
• **Example:** They invited us to their wedding.
 
 
 
• **he **(वह (पुरुष)): Used to refer to a male person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.
 
 
• **Example: **He is going to the market.
 
 
 
• **it** (यह): Used to refer to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.
 
 
• **Example:** It is raining outside.
